create_scannet_dataset: create a ScannetVoxelizationDataset instance with config, transforms, augmentation, and dataset phase for semantic segmentation training
load_scannet_data: load point cloud coordinates, features, and labels from a ScanNet scene file by index using load_data
augment_location_feature: augment a point cloud by appending a scaled location feature column using _augment_locfeat
save_upsampled_features: save upsampled point cloud features mapped back to the original point cloud space using save_features
map_to_original_pointcloud: map voxelized coordinates back to the original point cloud using inverse transformation and KNN via get_original_pointcloud
